login.title: Admin access
login.subtitle: Enter the admin passkey to manage the deforestation layers.

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
errors.notEnabled: The layers admin is not enabled on this server.
errors.forbiddenOrigin: This site is not allowed to manage layers.

layers.title: Layers
layers.subtitle: Published layers appear in the deforestation analysis. Hidden layers are not shown, but earlier analyses that use them keep working.
layers.loadError: The layers could not be loaded.
layers.needsRaster: Upload a raster before publishing the layer.
layers.toggleError: The layer's state could not be changed.

form.created: Layer created. Now upload its raster so it can be published.
form.saveError: The layer could not be saved.

errors.requiredInLanguage: Name and alias are required in {{language}}.
errors.baselineAfterComparison: The baseline year can't be after the comparison year
errors.reference: Must start with http:// or https://

raster.none: This layer has no raster yet.
raster.requirements: A single-band GeoTIFF with values 0 (no loss) and 1 (loss). Every pixel is checked and the file is converted to an optimized GeoTIFF; the layer keeps its current raster until the process succeeds.
raster.dropText: or drag it into this box
raster.nodataHelp: Only if the file doesn't declare one, e.g. 3.

report.title: Raster details
report.resolutionValue: {{meters}} m (use it as the pixel size)

uploadErrors.tooLarge: The file is larger than the server accepts.
uploadErrors.busy: Another raster is being processed. Try again in a few minutes.
uploadErrors.generic: The raster could not be uploaded.

issues.not_geotiff: The file is not a readable GeoTIFF.
issues.band_count: The raster must have exactly one band (it has {{bands}}).
issues.not_integer: The raster must have integer values (it has {{dtype}}). Use 0 for no loss and 1 for loss.
issues.no_crs: The raster must have a coordinate reference system.
issues.nodata_is_loss: Nodata cannot be 1 because 1 represents forest loss. Use a different nodata value.
issues.resolution_unavailable: The raster's pixel size could not be determined from its reference system and grid.
issues.resolution_mismatch: The layer pixel size ({{declared}} m) differs from the raster ({{measured}} m). Update the layer pixel size or choose another raster.
issues.not_binary: The raster must be binary (0 = no loss, 1 = loss). Other values found: {{values}}. If one of them marks nodata, upload it again with that value.
issues.loss_years: The raster has values that look like loss years ({{values}}). Binarize it against its baseline year before uploading.
issues.conversion_mismatch: The conversion didn't keep every pixel, so nothing was changed.
issues.interrupted: The process was interrupted because the server restarted. Upload the file again.
issues.unexpected: An unexpected error happened while processing the raster.
issues.nodata_ignored: The file already declares nodata {{declared}}; the value {{requested}} was ignored.
issues.no_loss_pixels: The raster has no loss pixels (value 1).
